adjudication.rationale: The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens.ts at lines 6-14 making a fetch call to process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT without any timeout/AbortController. This is a valid concern - if the external endpoint hangs, the request will block indefinitely. However, this is not strictly a 'bug' (the code will work correctly when the endpoint responds), but rather a missing defensive programming practice for a new feature. It's a legitimate architectural concern about the new credential sync functionality.
